# Cueboard

> A free, browser-local content planner for individual YouTube and Instagram creators.

Plan video ideas by editable themes, track progress and keep completed work below a shared divider. Optional YouTube integration adds a posting calendar and read-only video metrics. Planning requires no Cueboard account or API key.

## Pages
- [Content board and product overview](https://abhishek325.github.io/Cueboard/): Planner, features and common questions.
- [Getting started](https://abhishek325.github.io/Cueboard/guide/): Themes, idea details, progress, backups and optional YouTube setup.
- [Privacy and data](https://abhishek325.github.io/Cueboard/privacy/): Browser storage, backup contents, Google permissions and deletion.
- [Source and setup](https://github.com/Abhishek325/Cueboard): Vue, Dexie, Vite, testing and deployment documentation.

## Product facts
- Themes, ideas and progress are stored in this browser's IndexedDB, not a Cueboard server.
- Export/restore JSON to move boards. No automatic device sync or cloud backup.
- Board exports exclude credentials and fetched analytics.
- Public YouTube data requires the visitor's own API key. Private analytics and scheduled uploads require their own OAuth client and owner sign-in. Access is read-only.
- Cueboard does not upload, publish, schedule videos or connect to Instagram's API.
- The planner is free; Google API usage is subject to Google's quotas and terms.

This summary is optional documentation, not a crawler permission file or a guarantee of AI-search inclusion. Personal browser data is not served in the site's public HTML.
